translation.name: GOD ETER AGERKE NAMDERASEM TUMA YENBO

book.name: LUK
book.title: LUK Luk ere basem Tuma Yenbo. Kiyi late tuma.

content: Jisas ere wusom pelmenem tame erne eyarem.
Akeite ege si yabel Jisas ere Farisi apeilake eri akek a ate wurim. Wurim, tatame eme erne noub lakerebetem. Kap ere ege si yabelke tame eyarte, o? Eke eme erne lakerebetem.
Lakerebetem, tame wuri eri wusom pelmenem, ere yan temenem.
Temenem, Jisas ere erne lan ere Farisi tameken Moses eri wule tuma wusoubetem tameken emne etep wometem. Moses eri wule mapeke wobe? Ege si yabel nema tatame emne yenbo nente o nema emne beke nente?
Etep womke, eme tuma eikse tem. Tuma eikse tem, Jisas ere ete tame erne letke keren erne eyaren erne won yim.

Yim, ere emne etep wom. Kemri tame wuri eri yen o bulmakau ere ege si yabelke okmoike warte, maime ere ege si yabelke kuyese sene nenewayete, o ere sene beke kip nenewaye? Ye. Tame ere erne ege si yabelke kuyese sene nenewayete.
Etep womke, eme ete tuma awosein beke wo.
Jisas ere wom. Tame ere eter maime teitkwunte.
Jisas ere lam, tame kau eme a ate yam, eme wolbaye yenbok site wom. Etep lam, ere emne bepou sekur sakur tumak etep wom.
Tame ere ta neisbe a ate ere nene won yate, ne wolbaye yenbok mane site. Kap maime ere sig eisau tetan tame erne kir won yate.
Ne kiyi yin wolbaye yenbok simente, a ate woye tame ere yan nene etep wote. Ete wolbaye yenbo ne sigken tame erne newon site. Etep wote, ne sebera yan ne selke site.

Tame ere nene a ate won yate, ne yan selke site. A maime ere yan nene etep wote. Ne selke mane site. Ne gwok yan wolbaye yenbok site. Etep wote, ne sig eisau ek pette. Tatame nogwape, nerenken a abe tatame, eme etep late.
Tame ere eteri sig maime eisau wote, God ere ete tame eri sig nebule wote. Tame ere eteri sig maime teitkwunte, God ere ete tame eri sig eisau wote.
Tatame eme nemne wos awosein kuyese beke newo, nema emne noub eyar nente.

Jisas erne a ate wom tame erne ere etep wom. Ne awos kiste, ne neri tamenowu, lakemase, anenawo, yei, meim, wopu, wosbasken kom tame emne mane won yan a ate. Ne emne won yate, yuri eme nene a awosein kisin nene wote, e yaper.
Ne a eisau nente, wosken berai tatame, let nai tewo nai tatame, le si tatame etemwoune ne won yate.
Won yatek, yuri eme nene aom awosein beke kip newo. Etepkap ne metekwaste. Yuri tatame yenbo eme sele meike sene wayen yite yabel, God ere nene awosein newote. Jisas ere etep wom.
Awos eisau sekur sakur tuma.
Eterken abetem tame etemri wuri ere ete tuma metem, ere Jisas erne etep wom. Tatame eme God eri panen site komke sin awos ate, eme metekwaste.
Jisas ere sekur sakur tumak awosein etep wom. Apeilake tame wuri ere awos eisau nenem, ere tatame nogwape emne a ate wom.
Wom, awos ate yabel temke, ere eri yaku kerebe tame emne won yin kiyi wom tatame emne etep wom. Kem epe yate. Awos eme kiyi eyarye.
Etep wom, eme wurare wurare beke ya. Tame wuri ere etep wom. An sel tukem, an ete sel yin late. Kobo labe, an beke kip ya.
Akeite tame wuri ere etep wom. An yaku kerebe bulmakau ep yekwo let ep yekwo let tukem. An bulmakau terulan yaku kerete. Kobo labe, an beke kip ya.
Etep womke, akeite tame wuri ere etep wom. Gwopte an ta paneye. Kobo labe, an beke kip ya. Gwopte an ta paneye. Etep wom.

Yaku kerebe tame ere sene yin apeilake erne emri wom tuma wusowum. Wusowum, apeilake ere etep metem, ere pap wayen yaku kerebe tame erne etep wom. Ne kom sagke agetage yite. Kelu eisauken kelu nebuleken ne etek yin late. Wosken berai tatame, let nai tewo nai tatame, le si tatame, tewo yaper te tatame emne ne ari akek panen yate.
Etep womke, ere yin emne lam, yuri ere sene yan etep wom. An neri woye tuma nenye. Nogwape eme yan siye, wolbaye kau bepou som tetan.

Apeilake ere yaku kerebe tame erne etep wom. Ne sene yite. Ne komluke yibe, nowke yibe keluken boulke yibe kelu nebuleken yin lan tatame emne let tobo keren panen yate, eme ari akek yate. Eme yate, ari ake pelaute.
An kiyi wom tame eme ari a beke kip pet. Jisas ere sekur sakur tuma etep wom.
Jisas ere etep wom. Kem noub abon arenken yate.
Yuri Jisas ere yibetem, tatame nogwape eme eterken yibetem, ere petkwo lan emne etep wom.
Tame ere arenken yite wobe, ere eteri anenawo, yenta, geisimase, eteri maime wusom peiktamekap beke kip abo, ere ari anepoi tame beke kip te.
Aren mette muskap tame ere kir meten arenken yite. Tame ere etep mo wote, ere mus mette mo wote, ere ari anepoi tame kuyese beke kip te.
Tame ere ake eisau kerete abote, kiyi ere sin ake kerete kel noub sarte. Eri kel ere kuyese keren omote, o kuyese beke kip keren omo. Ere etep kiyi abote.
Ere kel kiyi beke abo, ere kwat tuken, mesginte. Ere kelken berai, ere kuyese beke kip kere. Tatame nogwape eme etep late, eme ete tame erne sak keyete. Eme erne etep wote.
Tame ere ake kwat tukem, ere beke kere. Etep wote.

Apeilake ere eteri ei nai tame nogwape (10 tausen) emne panen yin akeite apeilake eri ei nai tame nogwapewai (20 tausen) ei nai tameken yin naite, ere kiyi sin noub abote. Ere akeite apeilake eterken kuyese naite, o kuyese beke kip nai?
Ere abolawoite, kuyese beke kip nai wote, peiktame eme kaike som temente, ere emne tuma wopitin etep wote. Nema sene sin tuma namden eyaren gerute. Nema ei beke kip nai. Etep wote.
Jisas ere sene etep wom. Eme kiyi sin abobekap, kem etep kiyi sin abote. Tame ere eri wos nogwape magel beke kip tai, ere ari anepoi tame beke kip yi.
Tuma beke kute weyeke.
Weyeke ere wos yenbo. Weyeke sene ere tuma beke kute, e weyeke sega.

Weyeke sega e wos toboger beke yewo. Nema bulmakau etemri seken beke kip ras, nowri awos beke kip noub waye. Berai. Nema bepou me kelpe emik sepitbe. Kem eike wanken, kem tuma somo mette. Jisas ere etep wom.
